collegeList.name: Guru Kashi University
collegeList.description:
Guru Kashi University got approval by University Grant Commission (UGC) in 2011 and the first college was established in 1997. GKU is the fastest growing university in India, having A++ accreditation from the National Assessment and Accreditation Council (NAAC) of India.

In 2001, GGS College of Engineering & Technology was established, followed in 2005 by GGS College of Education. In 2006, GGS Institute of IT and Research and the GGS College of Nursing & GGS Collegiate Public School were established in 2009. Finally all courses came under one umbrella “GKU”, which came into existence in 2011. Guru Kashi University was established by Punjab Act No. 37 of 2011.
